title: M. Kartika Chendorain-Tulusan (Founder, GoodSpot; Cambridge Judge) — 'Eric is such a downer' — an anonymized cautionary tale of the CEO who ignored Eric's pre-IPO warning
summary: Chendorain-Tulusan founded GoodSpot, which builds privacy-first AI for preventative health. She retold a cautionary story from Eric's Mishcon de Reya conversation in Cambridge: five months after the IPO the stock fell 70%, the board removed the CEO within six months, and the company was sold off in pieces within five years.
blockquote: I met Eric Ries. Eric is such a downer. That won't happen to you. You're a visionary! A decade earlier, the CEO of a multibillion-dollar startup sought Ries's advice before an IPO. Ries flagged weak points in the company's governance structure, alarming the CEO but the founder's bankers and lawyers dismissed the warning with "Eric is such a downer…" reassuring him he was the exception to the rule. Can you already guess what happened next?
